title: Mojat gubal yan gibbatu
intro: Nabiyyi, isi farmol quukak, isi ummattak allal kee qammalsime wayta gibbatu fan kaa beyte margaqa bee. Kay safar diraamatik maynaqul beeh, kay imaan kee sabri giffole gital gibbatak suge. atu ta qaadik tan tekkookah addatino xayyowteh tan rortittek tayyaaqem duuddaa?
clues: Nabiyyi ummattah ruube, takkay immay sissikuk gexe, ken cinnat bakcarriteh.
Kay safar baddi fanah kaa beeh, tokkel usug qilsi quuka le doonik gexak gexa.
kaxxa silayti ugutte, markab meysisso, kee margaqa elle tekkem inki num doonik amol qidaanam quuka iffonta, mangoomul faatacisen.
usuk gineenit yanxuqeh suge, assakat le tekkooka yallih fayxil madqimteh.
Gino baguk waadoh addat, usuk isi Rabbih seeceeh, toobitteeh, diteh addat Yalla faylissak.
Kaxxa dooqah udduruuk lakal, usuk barren baddi qaxih amol qide, qaku luk sugeeh, laakin manol sugeeh, lakal kaadu isi ummatta ellecaboh elle yaamineenim geyuh yuduureh.

trial.answer: Kaxxa kullumti bagih addat aban safar

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
